# Kaleidoscope

Folds the frame into mirrored wedges around a point, like looking through a kaleidoscope.

<EffectDemo effect="kaleidoscope" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { kaleidoscope } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/kaleidoscope';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(kaleidoscope({ preset: 'snowflake' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.segments = 6`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter  | Type   | Default      | Range     | Description                               |
| ---------- | ------ | ------------ | --------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `segments` | number | `6`          | 2 – 24    | Number of wedges.                         |
| `center`   | [x, y] | `[0.5, 0.5]` | 0 – 1     | Center of the kaleidoscope.               |
| `rotation` | number | `0`          | 0 – 360 ° | Rotation of the wedges.                   |
| `offset`   | number | `30`         | 0 – 360 ° | Which part of the image each wedge shows. |
| `zoom`     | number | `1`          | 0.25 – 3  | Zooms the image inside the wedges.        |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                  |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `snowflake` | `segments: 12`, `zoom: 0.8`               |
| `mandala`   | `segments: 16`, `zoom: 1.4`, `offset: 90` |
| `twofold`   | `segments: 2`                             |
| `tunnel`    | `segments: 8`, `zoom: 2.5`                |

Apply one with `kaleidoscope({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Distortion & warp · tracked as story X9.6 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 27.7 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 5.5 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/kaleidoscope`, including the shared effect runtime.
